title: Why girls have worse mental health than boys
title_zh: 为什么女孩的心理健康比男孩更差
abstract: Analyses of data from more than 3,000 adolescents found that loneliness and desire for thinness contribute to the higher prevalence of depressive symptoms and suicidal ideation among girls than in boys. Young people’s perspectives informed the pathways that were investigated.
abstract_zh: 对3000多名青少年的数据分析发现，孤独和对身材苗条的渴望导致女孩比男孩更常出现抑郁症状和自杀念头。青少年的观点指导了所调查的途径。
